title: Pan-Seared Samphire with Brine-Infused Stew
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish featuring pan-seared samphire and a rich brine-infused stew.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the samphire and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until tender.
In a separate saucepan, heat the brine and stew over low heat.
Season the brine-infused stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the pan-seared samphire with the brine-infused stew.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
